answer: By the yarrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the knoll until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
